deviations.what: ariaLabelledBy on sap.m.Carousel (since UI5 1.125, source-verified in Carousel.js) is newer than 1.71 but kept for the 1:1 port - it is what links the Carousel to the sample's Title. The app needs a UI5 release >= 1.125 for the association to take effect; the Carousel itself renders on 1.71.

the four Images bind src against the demo kit's named img JSONModel (img>/products/pic1, pic2, pic3, screw). abap2UI5 serves one default model, so the four fixed values are inlined as literals off one shared base URL and host-absolutized to https://sdk.openui5.org/ (app 031 precedent) - same images, same order, same rendering.
